record.title: DfCM MEASURE run control
record.body: MEASURE R3 began from a fresh Project #2 snapshot of 368 items. Revalidated memory identifies independent qualified consumer replication as the weakest multiplier. The live candidate portfolio preserves R57 current-main reconciliation, real-ggen/R56 compatibility measurement, independent consumer-replication expansion, cross-repo qualification reuse, and memory-to-manufacture latency instrumentation.
